message: The schema components.schemas.Needle (named by its x-fern-type-name) is named "Foliage", which is already declared by the schema components.schemas.Leaf (named by its x-fern-type-name) at #/components/schemas/Leaf/x-fern-type-name. Both become Fern types named "Foliage" in the same file, so Fern keeps only one of them and silently drops the other; references to the dropped schema point to the one Fern keeps. Rename one of them with x-fern-type-name.
